findings.counterexample: FOLDED: the default .totem/ set (secrets and the nine local-state patterns) always rides, and a configured totemDir adds its own set beside it rather than replacing it; the comment now says why (add-secret.ts:11-12 and 76-77 hard-code '.totem/secrets.json' and path.join(cwd, '.totem') while the readers use totemDir, core/src/secrets.ts:104). The writer's own path is filed separately with the hook templates. The configured-dir tests assert both sets.

findings.claim: All nine local-state patterns resolve through the configured totemDir.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED with B1: the MCP, core and CLI writers do (ledger-writer.ts:50/62, search-knowledge.ts:1276, pipeline.ts:923, pack-discovery.ts:323, sync.ts:32), but the session-start templates init installs hard-code the ledger (init-templates.ts:323, 470, 1003, 1292 join process.cwd(), '.totem', 'ledger'); the default set beside the configured one covers them. The hard-coded writers are filed as their own issue.

findings.claim: The output matches the pre-fold output except for three deltas, pinned by tests including 'writes the whole block under one header'.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: the two further deltas (an empty file no longer gets a leading blank line; with .lancedb present and no header the secrets line now sits under the header instead of above it) are disclosed in the PR and the second is pinned by a new test on the input '.lancedb/\n' that fails on the pre-fold writer; the 'node_modules/' case stays as a regression guard and is named as non-discriminating. findings.claim: For '.', a leading '/' means a root-level *.jsonl never reaches the project's own files.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: the comment now says the slash keeps nested files out and the patterns reach exactly the root-level state files and directories (the probe: '/*.jsonl' matched a.jsonl and not sub/b.jsonl). A totemDir carrying a gitignore pattern character ('#', '!', '*', '?', '[', ']', '\\') or a '..' segment no longer reaches the writer: the default lines are written and a summary row says the configured directory was skipped (new test on '#state').

findings.claim: A line the project has re-included with ! is never written over.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED as prose: the README and the changeset now say an EXACT '!' line for one of these entries keeps that entry out; variants and a re-included child under an excluded directory are git's own semantics (check-ignore '.gitignore:2:.totem/ledger/' in the probe) and are not claimed.

findings.claim: In one atomic write under one # Totem header.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED as prose: 'in one atomic write, under a # Totem header when the file has none'; additions after an existing header are appended at the end of the file, which the doc comment now says.
